page: Microsoft Azure EC8ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the ECadsv6 server family. It is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.
This server includes 307 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not feature any GPU accelerators.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is configured as a memory-optimized resource. The inclusion of dedicated vCPUs and local SSD storage makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high memory density and fast local scratch space without the overhead of a GPU. It is suited for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, and data processing tasks.
